plan: This is a second-price auction format where I pay the second-highest bid if I win, not my own bid. This means my bid only affects whether I win, not what I pay. The dominant strategy in a second-price auction is to bid exactly my true value - bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth to me, and bidding lower risks losing auctions I could have profitably won. With my value at $23, I should bid $23 to maximize expected profit.

This is a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid if I win, not my own bid). In second-price auctions, bidding your true value is the dominant strategy—it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' bids. Bidding higher than value risks winning at a loss; bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. With no prior history to adjust from, I'll bid exactly my value of $25.
